canonical_repository.name: 7guard-io/7ya.io
canonical_repository.role: only canonical source-control and review plane

principles: A plan is not an outcome

canonical_release.scope: Igor-led Living OS, 66-record content museum, personal creator guidance and public-good workflows

active_change.purpose: Attach and safely cut over 7ya.io to the verified canonical Vercel recovery project
active_change.head_resolution_rule: Deployment provenance is determined from runtime X-7YA-Source-SHA and release.json, not from an unpinned branch name

verified_runtime_contract: HTTP 200 on every critical route and release asset
immutable source SHA header equals the release content source SHA
content-aware MIME types for HTML, CSS and JavaScript
release.json reports PR 211, the expected release ID and source SHA
personal onboarding enables only after three selections
impact-mode POST to /api/guide returns a structured local-coach response
runtime logs show no error or fatal entries after the production gate
deployment.public_domain_alignment: 7ya.io still serves the older public origin and has not been cut over to the verified canonical recovery alias
deployment.rollback: Previous immutable Vercel deployments and Git source SHAs remain available

content_system.name: History Song
content_system.ingestion_contract: DISCOVER → NORMALIZE → DEDUPLICATE → PROTECT → VERIFY → PUBLISH → SNAPSHOT
evidence_tiers: TIER_3 dated export or analytics snapshot
